displayName: PHP Runtime Spawning Interactive Shell or Download Utility

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("php", "php-cgi", "php-fpm")
| where FileName in~ ("sh", "bash", "dash", "cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "curl", "wget", "python3", "perl")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: PHP Runtime Spawning Interactive Shell or Download Utility
alertTemplate.description: Detects PHP interpreter or PHP-FPM/CGI worker processes launching OS shells or network download utilities, indicating exploitation of critical PHP vulnerabilities. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1144, ISM-1405, ISM-1690. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-21-php-critical-vulnerabilities, acsc-2026-11-17-vulnerabilities-patch-protect-prevent.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Check PHP version and patch status immediately, inspect HTTP access logs for exploit payloads, and review the host for persistence (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1144, ISM-1405, ISM-1690; Advisories: acsc-2026-10-21-php-critical-vulnerabilities, acsc-2026-11-17-vulnerabilities-patch-protect-prevent).
